text:
ana rao: FYI hitting weird BLEU drop on new asteria-int8 bringup when serving vertical CJK paragraphs — looks like embedding splitters insert extra separators in middle of han characters.

priya_m: repro? test set + minimal example pls

ana rao: repro inc — run this locally (kv cache warm):
```
PYTHONPATH=. python -m tests.run_eval --model asteria-int8 --dataset news_zh_vertical --batch 1 --maxlen 1024
```
Got BLEU from 34.1 -> 27.8 after int8 conversion.

kai_chen: saw similar with vertical text earlier. logs show `tokenizer.add_separator()` being called mid-grapheme. paste log snippet:
```
[2026-03-01 14:02:11] TOKENIZE src: '漢字\n漢'
-> tokens: ['漢', '<SEP>', '字', ...]
```
That would break embeddings/attention.

luis-g: embedding profiler shows split at byte boundary before quant. Int8 kernel expects `embed_concat` shape (B, L, D) but got (B, L+1, D) because of separator tokens; unit cost up and quality down.

eval-bot: CI eval: asteria-int8|news_zh_vertical BLEU delta -6.3 (regression threshold -2.0) — see https://ci.redwood/asteria/225000/compare

priya_m: can you run tokenization diff? maybe `unicode_grapheme` vs `char` setting changed in tokenizer config for vertical mode.

ana rao: attaching tokenizer config from new model:
```
{ "mode": "vertical", "split_policy": "legacy_byte", "use_grapheme_cluster": false }
```
Old quantized model had `use_grapheme_cluster: true`.

sean: quick patch that fixed it in staging: set `use_grapheme_cluster=true` and rerun int8 quant with `--stable-tokenization`. Also we found `embed-splitter` stage ran before detokenization normalization in compile pipeline.

kai_chen: bisect points to commit `a1f9b3c` where we refactored `embed-splitter` to optimize for per-row alignment. That change added a fast path that assumed no soft separators in vertical layout.

luis-g: proposed mitigation: in runtime, filter `\u2060` and `\u200B` zero-widths before splitter; and enforce `stable-tokenization` flag during quantization jobs.

ana rao: will test today. if fix works we should add regression test: news_zh_vertical + synthetic mixed-width paragraphs.

priya_m: I'll draft a small unit test and add to `eng-ml/qa` harness. ping me once you have repro logs.

ana rao: thanks — tagging @sean for rollout plan. :thumbsup:
